services.name: Tilton River Canyon Kayak
services.desc: A flatwater, beginner kayak or canoe day trip that offers stunning canyon paddling with a huge reward for the short, easy paddle. With so many volcanoes surrounding us, it’s difficult to decide what of the 5 amazing rivers to kayak on any given day. In March, before the Maples have leafed out, the forest can seem gloomy, moody, and spooky. But the Tilton River Canyon section is beautiful every single day of the year. This time of the year means you’ll likely have the place to yourself, and the lack of glacial flour means spotting salmon in the shallows is easy. services.name: Our Cabins
services.desc: At Packwood Station, we believe in supporting the people who make this community thrive. Our cabins are part of a collaborative effort to provide affordable, long-term housing for the folks who help keep Packwood safe, welcoming, and running smoothly. Most of our cabins are leased to local businesses, first-responders, and community members who call this place home. We’re proud to work with local organizations, small businesses, and non-profits to ensure that Packwood remains a place where those who serve the town can also live in it. blurb: Packwood station is the perfect vacation rental for your adventure to Mount Rainer National Park. Experience history renting one of our historic ranger cabins, or rent the whole station for your event or family reunion. Enjoy the best of download Packwood within working distance, while still having 20 acres to roam and explore. We even have our own waterfall on the property!
